stories.headline: PIONER ends development as studio says it cannot fund its servers
stories.summary: GFAGames says it has been unable to secure the funding needed to keep developing and operating its post-apocalyptic multiplayer shooter. PIONER entered Steam Early Access in December 2025, but the studio now plans to shut the game down. No server-offline date has been announced, and the developer has not confirmed refunds.

stories.headline: Spirit Crossing launches its cozy multiplayer world on Steam November 16
stories.summary: Spry Fox's upcoming cozy building and exploration MMO lets players decorate a mountain home, befriend spirits and choose how much they interact with other players. Its Steam listing confirms a November 16 PC release, with solo-friendly play as well as shared activities.

stories.headline: League of Legends Worlds final: Gen.G meets Bilibili Gaming today
stories.summary: The 2026 World Championship concludes in Brooklyn on November 14, with South Korea's Gen.G facing China's Bilibili Gaming in a best-of-five final. Riot's broadcast begins at 20:00 with the opening ceremony ahead of the championship match, on official LoL Esports channels.

stories.headline: LoL Esports reveals 2027 Worlds in Japan and South Korea, MSI in Valencia
stories.summary: Riot has announced an expanded First Stand: All In tournament in China in 2027, with the event moving to Southeast Asia in 2028. The 2027 Mid-Season Invitational will be held in Valencia, Spain. Worlds 2027 will stage its Swiss round in Nagoya, then move to South Korea for the knockouts and Seoul final. Dates and further format details are still to come.

stories.headline: Crimson Desert developer Pearl Abyss expands AI use across its pipeline
stories.summary: In its latest earnings letter, Pearl Abyss says it is extending AI-assisted work across concept validation, repetitive tasks, content-production support and testing. The developer says gameplay and content decisions remain in human hands. The statement follows controversy over AI-generated artwork previously found in Crimson Desert.

stories.headline: 21 original Xbox games added to the PC backward-compatibility catalogue
stories.summary: Microsoft's PC backward-compatibility catalogue has expanded by 21 original Xbox titles, bringing the total to 25. Four entries now include achievements. The additions are legacy Xbox versions made available through the compatibility programme, rather than newly released Steam editions.

stories.headline: Fanatical launches build-your-own Steam Deck Verified game bundle
stories.summary: The Play on the Go Elite Collection promotion lets customers pick from 20 Steam Deck Verified games. At the time of the November 13 announcement, US prices started at $15 for two selections and fell to $7 per game when buying five or more. Bundle availability and regional prices can change.

stories.headline: Marvel Rivals will upgrade Storm's summer costume to Legendary tier
stories.summary: NetEase says it plans to upgrade Storm's summer costume to Legendary rarity around Christmas following feedback about uneven cosmetic support across heroes. The team also outlined new costumes and effects for Human Torch in early December and Cloak and Dagger in February. The dates remain targets rather than firm launch commitments.

stories.headline: GDC survey: 40% of game developers use generative AI, but 55% see harm
stories.summary: A GDC industry survey of more than 2,600 respondents found that 40% use generative AI at work, up from 36% in the previous survey. While 55% said its impact on the games industry is negative, 35% called it mixed and 8% positive. Among respondents using AI, research and brainstorming were the most common activities, followed by coding and debugging.

stories.headline: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle once tested a GTA-style wanted system
stories.summary: MachineGames design director Jens Andersson says the team once experimented with a Grand Theft Auto-style wanted level that brought in reinforcements when players fired guns. The aim was to keep gunplay from overwhelming Indiana Jones's improvisational fighting style. Developers ultimately relied on slower reloading and plentiful breakable melee weapons instead. The comments describe a discarded prototype, not an upcoming gameplay update.
